vids.desc: In this activity, students learn how Direct and Indirect Taxes work in real life. They understand which taxes they pay directly and which ones are added to the things they buy. Students will sort different taxes, think like smart taxpayers, and learn how taxes affect their daily life and the country’s services.

quiz.nm: Do you pay tax without knowing? 🧾

qs.q: What is a Direct Tax?

opts.1: A tax that is directly paid to the government by an individual or organization.
opts.2: A tax included in the price of goods and services.
opts.3: A tax that can be shifted to another person or entity.

qs.q: How does an Indirect Tax work?

opts.1: It is included in the price of goods and services and paid by the consumer.
opts.2: It is paid directly from an individual's income to the government.
opts.3: It cannot be shifted from the person who earns to someone else.

qs.q: Which of the following is an example of an Indirect Tax?
Anika's parents receive a monthly salary, and she sees a deduction labeled "Income Tax" on their payslip. What should Anika understand about this deduction?

opts.1: It is a Direct Tax paid directly from her parents' income to the government.
opts.2: It is an Indirect Tax that her parents will recover through other purchases.
opts.3: It is a tax that can be shifted to someone else in her family.

qs.q: Raj buys a packet of chips and notices a small tax amount added to the total bill. He wants to make a smart financial decision regarding this type of tax. What should Raj consider?

opts.1: Stop buying chips to avoid paying any tax at all.
opts.2: Understand that this is an Indirect Tax and consider it when budgeting.
opts.3: Ask the seller to reduce the tax amount on the bill.

assigns.desc: In this activity, students learn how Direct and Indirect Taxes work in real life. They understand which taxes they pay directly and which ones are added to the things they buy. Students will sort different taxes, think like smart taxpayers, and learn how taxes affect their daily life and the country’s services.
